# 3 bed detached house for sale

> OPEN VIEWING SATURDAY 3RD OF OCTOBER 12 NOON TO 12:30. No. 51 Cuan Glas, Bishop O' Donnell Road, is a beautiful 3 bed detached home in a wonderful condition, ready to walk into, and in pristine decorative order throughout. Featuring oil fired central heating, double glazing, luxury ensuite off master bedroom, fantastic kitchen fully fitted, and downstairs WC and WHB.
